description.value: Bing Kee Food Forest is a publicly accessible community food forest in Nanaimo, BC, listed under the City's parks and community gardens network. Food forests are designed to mimic layered forest ecosystems while producing edible plants, offering a distinctive green-space experience compared to conventional parks. Cyclists exploring Nanaimo's urban greenways may find it a pleasant and unusual detour.
